brief.scope: Adjudicate Claude 954c77's eight findings on GPT-6 lane-policy contract/data. Rule each with precise evidence, minimal coherent correction; no new architecture or broad audit. Verify gate/authority protection and its derivable inclusion rule without making legitimate dev maintenance unusable; exact read semantics; maintenance boolean; admission store/record schema; standing versus per-job grants; standing enum and false-output case. Verify the actual existing decisions tool/store contract before recommending a verb or fields; do not invent register capabilities or require a fresh human approval for already authorized routine work. Host custody assumptions must be explicit. Treat repeated commit-message reflow as nonblocking launcher history: no amend/rewrite in this slice. Return <=1200-word inline RULING with bounded correction targets and test-readiness requirements. Read-only: no source/tests/settings/host/DB/network edits or vendor launches.

findings.claim: PARTIAL. Named gate/dispatch entrypoints are unprotected inside `dev`'s `ops/` write root, so a routine `dev` job may rewrite `ops/bin/suites.sh`, `ops/bin/dispatch.sh`, `ops/bin/go.sh`, and `ops/conductor/tools/laneconf.py` while `ops/README.md` is blocked. Claude's directory correction is REJECTED: prefix `ops/bin/` matches prescribed P1 `ops/bin/example.sh`; prefix `ops/devlane/hooks/` would make ordinary hook work require maintenance. Do not protect `decisions.py` or `decisions.seed.json` as gates. Add those four exact paths. Inclusion rule: every exclusive dispatch lever and every suite/conformance gate entrypoint this contract already names is a protected exact path; directory prefixes that swallow ordinary `ops/bin/` tooling are forbidden. Unprotected ops writes still pass without a maintenance record.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c "import json; p=json.load(open('ops/lane-policy.json')); prot=set(p['protected_authority_paths']); print(p['profiles']['dev']['write_roots']); print([x for x in ['ops/bin/suites.sh','ops/bin/dispatch.sh','ops/bin/go.sh','ops/conductor/tools/laneconf.py','ops/README.md'] if x in prot]); print('ops/bin/' in prot, any(x.startswith('ops/bin/') for x in prot))"; sed -n '29p;36p;95p;275p;288p;293p' ops/conductor/lane-policy.md; git ls-files ops/bin ops/devlane/hooks | wc -l

findings.claim: UPHELD. `shared_read_roots` is a required key with no semantics, refusal, or case. As a read ceiling it excludes `src/` and `packages/` and contradicts :40-41 and P1. Define it as an additive shared-document allowance that never narrows profile or inspection reads. Application-source inspection stays the :40-41 grant, not this list. Add a case: `dev` reading `src/` to describe Symfony still passes.

UPHELD. The protected-path rule is stated three ways: :29 and :129 authorize by record alone; :95-96 is a necessary condition only for `authority_maintenance: true`. P4 exercises only the true-valued profile, so false-plus-record is untestable. State that `authority_maintenance: false` refuses every protected path even with a valid record; restate :29 and :129; add negative case `dev` plus valid maintenance record editing `ops/README.md` → `lane-write`. Unprotected ops tooling still needs no record.
findings.reproduce: sed -n '29p;95,96p;129p;296p' ops/conductor/lane-policy.md; python3 -c "import json; p=json.load(open('ops/lane-policy.json')); print({k:v['authority_maintenance'] for k,v in p['profiles'].items()})"

findings.claim: PARTIAL. Unnamed admission store/fields UPHELD; invented register columns REJECTED. Existing decisions contract (standing PROPOSED) has verbs add/list/show/ratify/reject/supersede/note/export/report and row fields id, question, home, standing, blocked_on, decided_by, decided_at, evidence, recorded_by, supersedes/superseded_by, created_at/created_by — no path/ref/digest columns. Store is `Path.home()/.local/state/<LANE_NAME>/decisions.db`; isolated dispatch HOME is not the owner host. `handwork.db` is a different grant; seed JSON is a birth export. Name that host store and `python3 ops/conductor/tools/decisions.py show <id>`. Admission is a `ratified` row: `home` is `ops/lane-policy.json`; `evidence` quotes the full git id and blob sha256; `decided_by` is the owner principal. `brief.policy.admission.record` is the decision id; `admission.sha256` is SHA-256 of the exact `show` stdout bytes. Trusted caller reads with the owner's host HOME, never the worker HOME. Host custody is an explicit assumption. Do not add columns, verbs, or a second store; naming the register does not ratify it.
findings.reproduce: sed -n '76,78p;99p;159,161p;234,235p;296p' ops/conductor/lane-policy.md; sed -n '1,8p;16,20p;36,70p' ops/conductor/decisions-register.md; sed -n '117,121p;253,264p' ops/conductor/tools/decisions.py; sed -n '1,20p' ops/conductor/handwork-ledger.md

findings.claim: UPHELD. :96-98 requires principal, admitted ref/digest, exact paths, purpose, and job/lineage; :103-104 says an existing owner instruction suffices. A standing instruction cannot carry per-dispatch fields. Split two forms. Standing grant: one ratified decision covering named path prefixes, applicable across jobs while the current admitted policy ref/digest holds; no job/lineage field. Per-job grant: only for paths outside every standing grant; carries principal, exact paths, purpose, job/lineage, and the admitted ref/digest. Work already covered by a standing grant needs no fresh owner act. Unprotected `dev` tooling needs neither. Candidate bytes still cannot self-authorize.

PARTIAL. Permitted `standing` set is unstated; adding `active` is REJECTED because the field is never an activation switch. Allowed value is exactly `proposal`; any other value refuses `lane-policy`. Activation remains owner admission of consumer revision, not this field. Add that negative case.

UPHELD. `allow_declared_outputs: false` is unused. All shipped profiles set it true. P3 sets both booleans false but only repository results; N6 tests missing declaration. Extend P3 so a present valid declared `out/` write under that fixture profile refuses `lane-write`.
findings.reproduce: sed -n '131,132p;295p;302p' ops/conductor/lane-policy.md; python3 -c "import json; p=json.load(open('ops/lane-policy.json')); print({k:v['allow_declared_outputs'] for k,v in p['profiles'].items()})"

RULING at c7ae2a2aecd8aa4576b05d923b33c93ca81daa6b against c06ed9442ba51c9e96aa8de9f9bde93d0843a6cc. F1 P1 protected set — PARTIAL. Gap UPHELD: `dev.write_roots` is `ops/`; `ops/bin/suites.sh`, `ops/bin/dispatch.sh`, `ops/bin/go.sh`, and `ops/conductor/tools/laneconf.py` are absent from `protected_authority_paths` while `ops/README.md` is present. A routine `dev` job may rewrite the suite entry, exclusive dispatch levers, and laneconf closure/literals module with no maintenance record. Contract :275 and :288 call those gates mandatory; :95 forbids routine protected edits. Claude's directory correction is REJECTED: prefix `ops/bin/` matches prescribed P1 `ops/bin/example.sh`; prefix `ops/devlane/hooks/` would pull hook tests into maintenance though hooks "may follow" (:272). `decisions.py` and `decisions.seed.json` are not gate entrypoints (F4).

Correction: add those four exact paths. Inclusion rule: every exclusive dispatch lever and every suite/conformance gate entrypoint this contract already names is a protected exact path; directory prefixes that swallow ordinary `ops/bin/` tooling are forbidden. Unprotected ops writes still pass without a maintenance record (:36).

F2 P2 shared_read_roots — UPHELD. Required key, two occurrences, no semantics, no refusal, no case. As a read ceiling it excludes `src/`/`packages/` and contradicts :40-41 and P1.

Correction: define it as an additive shared-document allowance that never narrows profile or inspection reads. Application-source inspection stays the :40-41 grant, not this list. Add a case: `dev` reading `src/` to describe Symfony still passes.

F3 P2 authority_maintenance boolean — UPHELD. :29 and :129 authorize protected edits by authorization alone; :95-96 is a necessary condition only for true-valued profiles. P4 exercises only `authority-maintenance`. False-profile-plus-record is untested.

Correction: `authority_maintenance: false` refuses every protected path even with a valid record. Restate :29 and :129. Add negative case: `dev` plus valid maintenance record editing `ops/README.md` → `lane-write`. Unprotected ops tooling still needs no record.

F4 P2 admission store — PARTIAL. Missing name/fields UPHELD; new register schema REJECTED. Existing `ops/conductor/decisions-register.md` (standing PROPOSED): verbs add/list/show/ratify/reject/supersede/note/export/report; row fields id, question, home, standing, blocked_on, decided_by, decided_at, evidence, recorded_by, supersedes/superseded_by, created_at/created_by. No path/ref/digest columns. Store is `Path.home()/.local/state/<LANE_NAME>/decisions.db`. Isolated dispatch HOME is not the owner host. `handwork.db` is a different grant. Seed JSON is a birth export, not the live store.

Correction: name that host store and `python3 ops/conductor/tools/decisions.py show <id>`. Admission is a `ratified` row: `home` is `ops/lane-policy.json`; `evidence` quotes the full git id and blob sha256; `decided_by` is the owner principal. `brief.policy.admission.record` is the decision id; `admission.sha256` is SHA-256 of the exact `show` stdout bytes. The trusted caller reads with the owner's host HOME, never the worker HOME; worker copies are not authority. Host custody is an explicit assumption (:234-235). Do not add columns, verbs, or a second store. Naming this register does not ratify it.

F5 P2 standing vs per-job — UPHELD. :96-98 demands job/lineage and admitted ref/digest; :103-104 says an existing owner instruction suffices. A standing instruction cannot carry per-dispatch fields.

Correction: split two forms. Standing grant: one ratified decision covering named path prefixes, applicable across jobs while the current admitted policy ref/digest holds; no job/lineage field. Per-job grant: only for paths outside every standing grant; carries principal, exact paths, purpose, job/lineage, and the admitted ref/digest. Work already covered by a standing grant needs no fresh owner act. Unprotected `dev` tooling needs neither. Candidate bytes still cannot self-authorize.

F6 P3 standing enum — PARTIAL. Unstated set UPHELD; adding `active` REJECTED (`never an activation switch`). JSON value is `proposal`.

Correction: allowed value is exactly `proposal`; any other value refuses `lane-policy`. Activation remains owner admission of consumer revision, not this field. Add that negative case.

F7 P3 allow_declared_outputs false — UPHELD. :131-132 is unused. All shipped profiles are true. P3 sets both booleans false but only repository results; N6 tests missing declaration.

Correction: extend P3 so a present valid declared `out/` write under that fixture profile refuses `lane-write`.

F8 P3 commit reflow — REJECTED as blocking. Trailer hoist at 9ca4727 is real (`Validation:` truncated; continuation stranded). This slice does not amend or rewrite launcher history.

TEST-READINESS (independent author; no tests here): keep P1 pass for `ops/bin/example.sh`; add `dev` writing `ops/bin/suites.sh` without maintenance → `lane-write`; F2 inspection case; F3 false-profile+record; P4 built from `decisions.py show` of a ratified admission under host HOME; standing-grant pass and outside-grant without per-job record refuse; unknown `standing` → `lane-policy`; P3 declared-output refuse.
